name: Actionlint

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  actionlint:
    name: actionlint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install actionlint
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Pinned to actionlint v1.7.12 release tarball.
          ACTIONLINT_VERSION="1.7.12"
          ACTIONLINT_SHA256="8aca8db96f1b94770f1b0d72b6dddcb1ebb8123cb3712530b08cc387b349a3d8"
          curl -fsSL -o actionlint.tar.gz \
            "https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v${ACTIONLINT_VERSION}/actionlint_${ACTIONLINT_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
          echo "${ACTIONLINT_SHA256}  actionlint.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf actionlint.tar.gz actionlint
          chmod +x actionlint

      - name: Run actionlint
        run: ./actionlint -color

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  PYTHONWARNDEFAULTENCODING: "1"

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@1c37ad07a6a961277cf70c0d37d6f313000f5884  # v10.3.0

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - run: uv sync --all-groups --locked

      - run: make lockcheck lint portable

  type-check:
    name: Type check (ty)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@1c37ad07a6a961277cf70c0d37d6f313000f5884  # v10.3.0

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - run: uv sync --all-groups --locked

      - run: make typecheck

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # "Test (3.13)" and "Test (3.14)" are required status checks in the main
        # branch ruleset; removing a version leaves its check pending forever.
        python-version: ["3.13", "3.14"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@1c37ad07a6a961277cf70c0d37d6f313000f5884  # v10.3.0

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - run: uv sync --all-groups --locked

      - run: uv run pytest -q -n auto tests/

  windows-test:
    name: Windows test (3.13)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@1c37ad07a6a961277cf70c0d37d6f313000f5884  # v10.3.0

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - run: uv sync --all-groups --locked

      - run: uv run pytest -q -n auto tests/

  dep-audit:
    name: Dependency audit (pip-audit)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@1c37ad07a6a961277cf70c0d37d6f313000f5884  # v10.3.0

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Export locked requirements
        run: |
          uv export --frozen --all-groups --format requirements-txt \
            --no-emit-project -o requirements-frozen.txt

      - name: Run pip-audit against the lockfile export
        run: uvx pip-audit -r requirements-frozen.txt --disable-pip --strict

  coverage:
    name: Coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@1c37ad07a6a961277cf70c0d37d6f313000f5884  # v10.3.0

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - run: uv sync --all-groups --locked

      - run: uv run coverage run --branch -m pytest -q tests/

      - name: Coverage report (gate)
        run: uv run coverage report

      - name: Coverage XML for upload
        run: uv run coverage xml -o coverage.xml

      - name: Upload coverage XML
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9  # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: coverage-xml
          path: coverage.xml

  build:
    name: Build sdist + wheel
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@1c37ad07a6a961277cf70c0d37d6f313000f5884  # v10.3.0

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Seed deliberately dirty workstation state
        run: |
          mkdir -p .claude .hypothesis .vivisect
          touch .claude/release-leak .hypothesis/release-leak .vivisect/release-leak

      - run: uv build

      - name: Verify artifact contents and version surfaces
        run: uv run python scripts/verify_artifacts.py dist/

      - run: uvx twine check dist/*

      - name: Smoke-import the wheel
        run: |
          python -m venv /tmp/wheel-check
          /tmp/wheel-check/bin/pip install dist/*.whl
          /tmp/wheel-check/bin/python -c "import calcifier; print(calcifier.__version__)"
          /tmp/wheel-check/bin/calcifier --version

"""Host CLI providers and custom command adapters."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from .agent_config import _CLAUDE_READ_TOOLS
from .agent_events import (
    AgentProvider,
    AgentResult,
    _run_cli,
)
from .filesystem_contract import AgentError, FilesystemContract
from .native_events import parse_adapter_envelope


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HostCommand:
    argv: list[str]
    preflight_features: tuple[str, ...]


def claude_command(
    binary: str,
    *,
    model: str | None = None,
    filesystem: FilesystemContract | None = None,
    schema: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> HostCommand:
    command = [
        binary,
        "-p",
        "--output-format=stream-json",
        "--verbose",
    ]
    writable = filesystem.writable_paths if filesystem is not None else ()
    tools = _CLAUDE_READ_TOOLS + (",Edit,Write" if writable else "")
    allowed = [
        _CLAUDE_READ_TOOLS,
        *(_claude_edit_rule(path) for path in writable),
    ]
    features: list[str] = []
    for flag in ("--no-session-persistence", "--safe-mode"):
        command.append(flag)
        features.append(flag)
    command.extend(
        (
            "--restricted",
            "--permission-prompts",
            "none",
            "--permission-mode",
            "dontAsk" if writable else "plan",
            "--strict-mcp-config",
        )
    )
    if writable:
        # Edit path rules also govern Write; protect directories and worktree .git files.
        command.extend(("--disallowedTools", "Edit(//**/.git/**)", "Edit(//**/.git)"))
    command.extend(("--tools", tools))
    features.append("--tools")
    command.extend(
        (
            "--allowedTools",
            *allowed,
            "--max-turns",
            "12",
        )
    )
    if model is not None:
        command.extend(("--model", model))
    if filesystem is not None:
        for path in filesystem.readable_paths:
            if path != filesystem.working_directory:
                command.extend(("--add-dir", str(path)))
    if schema is not None:
        command.extend(("--json-schema", json.dumps(schema, sort_keys=True)))
    return HostCommand(command, tuple(features))


def _claude_edit_rule(path: Path) -> str:
    # Claude uses gitignore patterns with // for filesystem-root absolute paths.
    pattern = path.as_posix()
    if path.drive and pattern[1:2] == ":":
        pattern = f"/{pattern[0].lower()}{pattern[2:]}"
    pattern = "".join("\\" + char if char in "*?[]\\" else char for char in pattern)
    return f"Edit(/{pattern.rstrip('/')}/**)"


def codex_command(
    binary: str,
    *,
    model: str | None = None,
    reasoning_effort: str | None = None,
    filesystem: FilesystemContract | None = None,
    schema_path: Path | None = None,
) -> HostCommand:
    command = [binary, "exec", "--color", "never"]
    writable = filesystem.writable_paths if filesystem is not None else ()
    features: list[str] = []
    command.append("--ephemeral")
    features.append("--ephemeral")
    command.append("--json")
    for flag in ("--ignore-user-config", "--ignore-rules"):
        command.append(flag)
        features.append(flag)
    command.extend(
        (
            "--sandbox",
            "workspace-write" if writable else "read-only",
            "--skip-git-repo-check",
            "--disable",
            "multi_agent",
            "--disable",
            "plugins",
            "--disable",
            "apps",
            "--disable",
            "browser_use",
            "--disable",
            "computer_use",
            "-c",
            "project_doc_max_bytes=0",
        )
    )
    if model is not None:
        command.extend(("--model", model))
    if reasoning_effort is not None:
        command.extend(("-c", f"model_reasoning_effort={json.dumps(reasoning_effort)}"))
    if filesystem is not None:
        command.extend(("-C" if writable else "--cd", str(filesystem.working_directory)))
        additional = [
            path for path in writable if not filesystem.working_directory.is_relative_to(path)
        ]
        for path in additional:
            command.extend(("--add-dir", str(path)))
        if writable:
            command.extend(("-c", "sandbox_workspace_write.exclude_slash_tmp=true"))
    if schema_path is not None:
        command.extend(("--output-schema", str(schema_path)))
        features.append("--output-schema")
    command.append("-")
    return HostCommand(command, tuple(features))


def host_provider_check(provider: str) -> tuple[list[str], tuple[str, ...]]:
    if provider == "claude":
        return [provider, "--help"], claude_command(provider).preflight_features
    if provider == "codex":
        return [provider, "exec", "--help"], codex_command(
            provider, schema_path=Path("output-schema.json")
        ).preflight_features
    raise ValueError(f"unsupported agent provider: {provider}")


def command_adapter_environment(
    filesystem: FilesystemContract | None,
    schema: dict[str, Any] | None,
    timeout_seconds: float | None,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    contract = {
        "version": 1,
        "filesystem": None if filesystem is None else filesystem.as_dict(),
        "schema": schema,
        "timeout_seconds": timeout_seconds,
    }
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment["CALCIFIER_AGENT_PROTOCOL"] = "1"
    environment["CALCIFIER_AGENT_CONTRACT"] = json.dumps(contract, sort_keys=True)
    return environment


# -- providers ----------------------------------------------------------------


class ClaudeCli(AgentProvider):
    """Headless Claude via the ``claude -p`` CLI."""

    name = "claude"

    target_name = "claude"

    def __init__(
        self,
        binary: str = "claude",
        *,
        role: str = "claude",
        default_timeout: float | None = None,
        model: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = role
        self.binary = binary
        self.default_timeout = default_timeout
        self.model = model

    def is_available(self) -> bool:
        return shutil.which(self.binary) is not None

    def invoke(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        *,
        timeout: float | None = None,
        filesystem: FilesystemContract | None = None,
        schema: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> AgentResult:
        command = claude_command(
            self.binary, model=self.model, filesystem=filesystem, schema=schema
        )
        return _run_cli(
            command.argv,
            stdin=prompt,
            timeout=self.effective_timeout(timeout),
            name=self.name,
            filesystem=filesystem,
            native_format="claude",
        )


class CodexCli(AgentProvider):
    """Headless Codex via the ``codex exec`` CLI."""

    name = "codex"
    native_structured_output = True

    target_name = "codex"

    def __init__(
        self,
        binary: str = "codex",
        *,
        role: str = "codex",
        default_timeout: float | None = None,
        model: str | None = None,
        reasoning_effort: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = role
        self.binary = binary
        self.default_timeout = default_timeout
        self.model = model
        self.reasoning_effort = reasoning_effort

    def is_available(self) -> bool:
        return shutil.which(self.binary) is not None

    def invoke(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        *,
        timeout: float | None = None,
        filesystem: FilesystemContract | None = None,
        schema: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> AgentResult:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="calcifier-codex-home-") as config_home:
            schema_path: Path | None = None
            if schema is not None:
                schema_path = Path(config_home) / "output-schema.json"
                schema_path.write_text(
                    json.dumps(schema, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n"
                )
            command = codex_command(
                self.binary,
                model=self.model,
                reasoning_effort=self.reasoning_effort,
                filesystem=filesystem,
                schema_path=schema_path,
            )
            _seed_codex_auth(Path(config_home))
            clean_env = {
                key: value
                for key, value in os.environ.items()
                if key in {"PATH", "OPENAI_API_KEY", "SSL_CERT_FILE", "SSL_CERT_DIR", "TMPDIR"}
            }
            clean_env["CODEX_HOME"] = config_home
            return _run_cli(
                command.argv,
                stdin=prompt,
                timeout=self.effective_timeout(timeout),
                name=self.name,
                filesystem=filesystem,
                env=clean_env,
                native_format="codex",
            )


class CommandCli(AgentProvider):
    """An explicitly configured argv-only subprocess provider."""

    target_type = "command"

    def __init__(
        self,
        role: str,
        command: tuple[str, ...],
        *,
        default_timeout: float | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = role
        self.command = command
        self.target_name = command[0]
        self.default_timeout = default_timeout

    def is_available(self) -> bool:
        return shutil.which(self.command[0]) is not None

    def invoke(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        *,
        timeout: float | None = None,
        filesystem: FilesystemContract | None = None,
        schema: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> AgentResult:
        effective_timeout = self.effective_timeout(timeout)
        adapter_env = command_adapter_environment(filesystem, schema, effective_timeout)
        return _run_cli(
            list(self.command),
            stdin=prompt,
            timeout=effective_timeout,
            name=self.name,
            filesystem=filesystem,
            env=adapter_env,
            event_parser=parse_adapter_envelope,
        )


def _seed_codex_auth(config_home: Path) -> None:
    original_home = Path(os.environ.get("CODEX_HOME", Path.home() / ".codex"))
    source = original_home / "auth.json"
    if not source.is_file():
        return
    destination = config_home / "auth.json"
    try:
        shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
        destination.chmod(0o600)
    except OSError as exc:
        raise AgentError(f"could not prepare isolated Codex authentication: {exc}") from exc

"""Recipe-facing agent calls."""

from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, get_args, get_type_hints

from . import trace as trace_module
from .agent_config import BUILTIN_AGENTS, ROLE_RE
from .filesystem_contract import AgentError, FilesystemContract, _filesystem_prompt
from .validation import bounded_timeout

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from typing_extensions import TypeForm

# -- user-facing Agent --------------------------------------------------------


class Agent:
    """Recipe-author handle for an agent provider.

    Calling the handle inside a ``@step`` body invokes the registered provider
    in structured-output mode using the active step's return annotation. The
    annotation can be overridden per call with ``output=<Type>``.

    The active ``Registry`` is read from the trace ``RunContext``; the runtime
    sets it on entry to ``execute()``. Calling outside of an active context
    raises ``AgentError``.
    """

    def __init__(self, provider_name: str) -> None:
        self.name = provider_name

    def __call__(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        /,
        *,
        working_directory: str | Path | None = None,
        readable_paths: tuple[str | Path, ...] = (),
        writable_paths: tuple[str | Path, ...] = (),
        output: Any | None = None,
        timeout: float | None = None,
        context: Any | None = None,
        **template_args: Any,
    ) -> Any:
        ctx = trace_module.current()
        if ctx is None or ctx.registry is None:
            raise AgentError(
                f"Agent {self.name!r} called outside an active recipe run (no registry in context)"
            )
        if ctx.allowed_agents is not None and self.name not in ctx.allowed_agents:
            raise AgentError(
                f"agent role {self.name!r} is not declared by the active recipe; "
                f"allowed: {sorted(ctx.allowed_agents)}"
            )
        active_frame = trace_module.current_frame()
        provider = ctx.registry.get(self.name)
        annotation = output
        if annotation is None:
            annotation = (
                ctx.parent_step_annotation if active_frame is None else active_frame.annotation
            )
            if annotation is None:
                raise AgentError(
                    f"Agent {self.name!r} called outside a @step body and no `output=` schema given"
                )
        rendered = _rendered_prompt(self.name, prompt, template_args)
        _require_agent_answer_type(annotation)
        rendered, readable_paths, host_delivery = _prepared_agent_context(
            rendered, readable_paths, context
        )
        filesystem = FilesystemContract.build(
            _agent_working_directory(working_directory, context),
            readable_paths,
            writable_paths,
            resource_root=ctx.resource_root,
        )
        rendered = _filesystem_prompt(filesystem, rendered, host_delivery=host_delivery)
        effective_timeout = provider.effective_timeout(timeout)
        if effective_timeout is None:
            raise AgentError(f"agent role {self.name!r} has no configured timeout")
        if ctx.budget_state is not None:
            ctx.budget_state.check_wall()
            effective_timeout = bounded_timeout(
                effective_timeout, ctx.budget_state.remaining_wall_seconds()
            )
        with trace_module.agent_call_frame(
            role=self.name,
            filesystem=filesystem.as_dict(),
            configuration_hash=ctx.registry.configuration_hash,
            **provider.trace_metadata(),
        ):
            if filesystem.writable_paths and ctx.dry_run is trace_module.DryRunMode.HARD:
                from .side_effects import SideEffectBlocked

                raise SideEffectBlocked("side effect blocked by hard dry-run: agent writable paths")
            return provider.structured(
                rendered,
                annotation=annotation,
                timeout=effective_timeout,
                filesystem=filesystem,
            )


def _require_agent_answer_type(annotation: Any, seen: set[int] | None = None) -> None:
    """Reject answer types that would let a model choose a host-prepared context."""
    from .prepared_context import PreparedContext

    visited = set() if seen is None else seen
    if id(annotation) in visited:
        return
    visited.add(id(annotation))
    if annotation is PreparedContext:
        raise AgentError("prepared contexts are issued by prepare_context(), not by agents")
    children = list(get_args(annotation))
    if isinstance(annotation, type) and dataclasses.is_dataclass(annotation):
        children.extend(get_type_hints(annotation, include_extras=True).values())
    for child in children:
        _require_agent_answer_type(child, visited)


def _agent_working_directory(working_directory: str | Path | None, context: Any) -> str | Path:
    if working_directory is not None:
        return working_directory
    if context is None:
        raise AgentError("working_directory is required without a PreparedContext")
    return Path.cwd()


def _prepared_agent_context(
    rendered: str,
    readable_paths: tuple[str | Path, ...],
    context: Any,
) -> tuple[str, tuple[str | Path, ...], bool]:
    """Add the original instructions, or a prepared context that already embeds them."""
    from .instruction_context import current_instructions
    from .prepared_context import PreparedContext

    authority = current_instructions()
    if authority is not None:
        readable_paths = (*readable_paths, authority.directory)
    if context is None:
        if authority is not None:
            rendered += "\n\n" + authority.prompt(_INSTRUCTION_BUDGET - 2)
        return rendered, readable_paths, authority is not None
    if not isinstance(context, PreparedContext):
        raise AgentError("agent context must come from prepare_context()")
    if rendered != context.prompt:
        rendered += "\n\n" + context.prompt
    return rendered, (*readable_paths, context.directory), True


# Inline instruction bytes for calls without a PreparedContext; the full text stays readable.
_INSTRUCTION_BUDGET = 65536


# Match ``{name}`` where ``name`` is a Python identifier. Anything else
# (``{}``, ``{0}``, ``{a.b}``, ``{...prose...}``, JSON object literals)
# stays literal — a safer subset of ``str.format`` for prompts that often
# contain JSON examples or schema fragments with stray braces.
_SAFE_PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r"\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}")


def _rendered_prompt(role: str, prompt: str, template_args: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    unused = sorted(name for name in template_args if f"{{{name}}}" not in prompt)
    if unused:
        raise AgentError(
            f"agent {role!r} got template arguments with no {{name}} placeholder in "
            f"its prompt: {unused}; check for a misspelled agent() option"
        )
    return _safe_substitute(prompt, template_args)


def _safe_substitute(prompt: str, kwargs: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    if not kwargs:
        return prompt

    def _sub(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        key = match.group(1)
        return str(kwargs[key]) if key in kwargs else match.group(0)

    return _SAFE_PLACEHOLDER.sub(_sub, prompt)


def agent[T = Any](
    role: str,
    prompt: str,
    /,
    *,
    working_directory: str | Path | None = None,
    readable_paths: tuple[str | Path, ...] = (),
    writable_paths: tuple[str | Path, ...] = (),
    output: TypeForm[T] | None = None,
    timeout: float | None = None,
    context: Any | None = None,
    **template_args: object,
) -> T:
    """Invoke a declared agent role using the active registry.

    ``output`` is a type expression such as an ``@output_type`` class,
    ``list[Model]``, or ``Annotated[str, word_count(1, 50)]``; the call returns
    that type, or the response text when ``output`` is omitted. With ``context``,
    the caller's working directory remains the default and the bundle is readable;
    otherwise declare a working directory explicitly. Extra paths default to none.
    Writable paths must be existing directories, with the working directory inside one.
    Agents may change files beneath them except .git paths; agents never commit.
    Recipes run git with run_command(). One signature,
    rather than overloads, lets a type checker name the exact argument that is
    wrong.
    """
    if ROLE_RE.fullmatch(role) is None:
        raise AgentError(f"invalid agent role name: {role!r}")
    if role in BUILTIN_AGENTS:
        raise AgentError(f"provider name {role!r} cannot be used as a semantic role")
    return Agent(role)(
        prompt,
        working_directory=working_directory,
        readable_paths=readable_paths,
        writable_paths=writable_paths,
        output=output,
        timeout=timeout,
        context=context,
        **template_args,
    )

@dataclass
class AgentActivity:
    """Aggregate attempted model calls, normalized usage, and elapsed wall time."""

    attempts: int = 0
    duration_seconds: float = 0.0
    usage: dict[str, float | int | None] = field(default_factory=empty_usage)
    max_model_calls: int | None = None
    model_calls: int = 0

    dry_run: DryRunResult | None = None

    reasoning_effort: str | None = None

    event_callback: Callable[[dict[str, object]], None] | None = field(
        default=None,
        repr=False,
        compare=False,
    )
    usage_reported_attempts: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    _active_timer: SuspendAwareTimer | None = field(default=None, repr=False, compare=False)

    def elapsed_seconds(self) -> float:
        """Include the running capture in incremental checkpoints."""
        return self.duration_seconds + (
            self._active_timer.elapsed() if self._active_timer is not None else 0.0
        )

    def record_event(
        self,
        phase: str,
        status: str,
        *,
        detail: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        event: dict[str, object] = {
            "sequence": len(self.events) + 1,
            "phase": phase,
            "status": status,
            "model_calls": max(self.model_calls, self.attempts),
        }
        if detail is not None:
            event["detail"] = detail
        self.events.append(event)
        if self.event_callback is not None:
            try:
                self.event_callback(dict(event))
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - diagnostics must never break compilation
                logger.exception("compiler progress callback failed")


_ACTIVITY_COLLECTORS: contextvars.ContextVar[tuple[AgentActivity, ...]] = contextvars.ContextVar(
    "calcifier_agent_activity_collectors", default=()
)
_ACTIVITY_LOCK = threading.RLock()


@contextmanager
def capture_agent_activity(activity: AgentActivity):
    """Capture agent activity in ``activity``, including failed invocations."""
    collectors = _ACTIVITY_COLLECTORS.get()
    token = _ACTIVITY_COLLECTORS.set((*collectors, activity))
    timer = SuspendAwareTimer.start()
    previous_timer, activity._active_timer = activity._active_timer, timer
    try:
        yield activity
    finally:
        activity.duration_seconds += timer.elapsed()
        activity._active_timer = previous_timer
        _ACTIVITY_COLLECTORS.reset(token)


def captured_agent_activities() -> tuple[AgentActivity, ...]:
    """Return active telemetry collectors for deterministic compiler stages."""
    return _ACTIVITY_COLLECTORS.get()


_STRUCTURED_DIRECTIVE = (
    "Return ONLY a JSON value that conforms to the supplied JSON schema. "
    "Do not include prose, markdown fences, or explanation — emit JSON only."
)
_RETRY_DIRECTIVE = (
    "Your previous response failed to parse: {error}. "
    "Return ONLY a JSON value strictly matching the schema."
)


class AgentProvider(ABC):
    name: str = "agent"
    native_structured_output: bool = False
    target_type: str = "builtin"
    target_name: str = "agent"
    runtime: AgentRuntime = AgentRuntime(kind="host")
    default_timeout: float | None = None
    remediation: str | None = None
    model: str | None = None
    reasoning_effort: str | None = None

    @abstractmethod
    def invoke(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        *,
        timeout: float | None = None,
        filesystem: FilesystemContract | None = None,
        schema: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> AgentResult: ...

    def structured(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        *,
        annotation: Any,
        timeout: float | None = None,
        filesystem: FilesystemContract | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        """Invoke with a JSON-schema directive derived from ``annotation``,
        parse the response into that type. One automatic retry appends the
        parser's error to the prompt. Providers receive an object-root schema:
        any other root is wrapped as ``{"value": ...}`` and unwrapped here.
        Open mappings and unconstrained values use a JSON string in that
        envelope; strict host parsing validates the decoded value."""
        schema = self._structured_schema(annotation)
        directive = _STRUCTURED_DIRECTIVE
        if not self.native_structured_output:
            directive += "\n\nSchema:\n" + json.dumps(schema, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
        full_prompt = f"{prompt}\n\n{directive}"
        _record_agent_prompt_size(full_prompt, schema)
        result = self.complete(
            full_prompt,
            timeout=timeout,
            filesystem=filesystem,
            schema=schema,
        )
        try:
            return self._parse_structured(result.text, annotation)
        except StructuredAttemptError as first_error:
            retry_prompt = f"{full_prompt}\n\n{_RETRY_DIRECTIVE.format(error=first_error)}"
            _record_agent_prompt_size(retry_prompt, schema)
            retry_result = self.complete(
                retry_prompt,
                timeout=timeout,
                filesystem=filesystem,
                schema=schema,
            )
            try:
                return self._parse_structured(retry_result.text, annotation)
            except StructuredAttemptError as second_error:
                # Stages only: validator messages can quote model output, which must not
                # reach run errors or traces.
                raise AgentError(
                    f"{self.name} returned no valid structured response after one retry "
                    f"(first attempt {first_error.stage}; second attempt {second_error.stage})"
                ) from second_error

    def _structured_schema(self, annotation: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return wire_schema(strict_schema_for(annotation))

    def _parse_structured(self, text: str, annotation: Any) -> Any:
        return validated_structured(
            text, annotation, json_encoded=needs_json_transport(strict_schema_for(annotation))
        )

    def complete(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        *,
        timeout: float | None = None,
        filesystem: FilesystemContract | None = None,
        schema: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> AgentResult:
        """Invoke once while recording the attempt and any normalized usage."""
        _mark_agent_attempt()
        ctx = trace_module.current()
        if ctx is not None and ctx.budget_state is not None:
            remaining = ctx.budget_state.remaining_wall_seconds()
            configured = self.effective_timeout(timeout)
            timeout = bounded_timeout(configured, remaining)
        result = self.invoke(
            prompt,
            timeout=timeout,
            filesystem=filesystem,
            schema=schema,
        )
        _record_agent_usage(result.usage, final=True)
        trace_module.record_agent_model(result.reported_model)
        return result

    def is_available(self) -> bool:  # pragma: no cover - trivial
        return True

    def trace_metadata(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "target_type": self.target_type,
            "target_name": self.target_name,
            "runtime": self.runtime.as_dict(),
            "configured_model": self.model,
            "reasoning_effort": self.reasoning_effort,
            "model_identity_source": "configured" if self.model is not None else "unavailable",
        }

    def effective_timeout(self, timeout: float | None) -> float | None:
        return self.default_timeout if timeout is None else timeout


def _mark_agent_attempt() -> None:
    with _ACTIVITY_LOCK:
        activities = _ACTIVITY_COLLECTORS.get()
        trace_module.mark_agent_attempt()
        for activity in activities:
            activity.attempts += 1


def _record_agent_usage(usage: Mapping[str, float | int | None], *, final: bool = False) -> None:
    with _ACTIVITY_LOCK:
        for activity in _ACTIVITY_COLLECTORS.get():
            add_usage(
                activity.usage,
                usage,
                reported_attempts=activity.usage_reported_attempts if final else None,
            )
    trace_module.record_agent_usage(usage, final=final)


def _record_agent_prompt_size(prompt: str, schema: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
    trace_module.record_agent_prompt(
        len(prompt.encode("utf-8")),
        len(json.dumps(schema, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")),
    )


# -- shared cli runner --------------------------------------------------------


def _check_timeout_budget() -> None:
    ctx = trace_module.current()
    if ctx is not None and ctx.budget_state is not None:
        ctx.budget_state.check_wall()


def _run_cli(
    cmd: list[str],
    stdin: str,
    *,
    timeout: float | None,
    name: str,
    filesystem: FilesystemContract | None = None,
    env: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    event_parser: Callable[[str], tuple[str, dict[str, float | int | None]]] | None = None,
    native_format: Literal["claude", "codex"] | None = None,
) -> AgentResult:
    if timeout is None:
        raise AgentError(f"{name} CLI requires an explicit timeout")
    stream = None if native_format is None else NativeEventStream(native_format)
    timeout_seconds = timeout
    try:
        completed = run_process(
            cmd,
            stdin=stdin.encode(),
            timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
            max_output_bytes=8 * 1024 * 1024,
            cwd=None if filesystem is None else filesystem.working_directory,
            env=env,
            stdout_consumer=None if stream is None else stream.consume,
        )
        if stream is not None:
            stream.finish()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        _failed_stream(stream, b"", event_parser, name)
        raise
    except ProcessTimeoutError as exc:
        _failed_stream(stream, exc.stdout, event_parser, name)
        _report_agent_diagnostic(name, exc.stderr_tail)
        _check_timeout_budget()
        raise TransientAgentError(f"{name} CLI timed out after {timeout_seconds:g}s") from exc
    except ProcessError as exc:
        _failed_stream(stream, exc.stdout, event_parser, name)
        _report_agent_diagnostic(name, exc.stderr_tail)
        _raise_transport_error(stream, exc, name)
    _report_agent_diagnostic(name, completed.stderr_tail)
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        _failed_stream(stream, completed.stdout, event_parser, name)
        raise AgentError(f"{name} CLI exited {completed.returncode}")
    if stream is not None:
        return _native_cli_result(stream, completed.returncode, name)
    return _text_cli_result(completed, event_parser, name)


def _raise_transport_error(
    stream: NativeEventStream | None, error: ProcessError, name: str
) -> None:
    if stream is not None:
        reason = (
            "native output rejected"
            if isinstance(error, ProcessOutputLimitError)
            else "transport failed"
        )
        raise AgentError(
            f"{name} CLI {reason}: {error}; " + json.dumps(stream.diagnostics(), sort_keys=True)
        ) from error
    if isinstance(error, ProcessOutputLimitError):
        raise AgentError(f"{name} CLI output exceeded 8388608 bytes") from error
    raise AgentError(f"{name} CLI failed to start: {error}") from error


def _native_cli_result(stream: NativeEventStream, exit_code: int, name: str) -> AgentResult:
    try:
        stream.require_completion()
    except AgentError:
        _failed_stream(stream, b"", None, name)
        raise
    _record_native_transport(stream, name, "completed")
    # Preserve earlier observations without claiming they were finally reported,
    # and without adding a partial count to the provider's final total.
    _record_agent_usage(
        {key: value for key, value in stream.partial_usage.items() if stream.usage.get(key) is None}
    )
    return AgentResult(
        text=stream.text,
        raw_stdout="",  # Native auxiliary events are deliberately not retained.
        raw_stderr="",
        exit_code=exit_code,
        provider=name,
        usage=stream.usage,
        reported_model=stream.diagnostics()["reported_model"],
    )


def _text_cli_result(
    completed: ProcessResult,
    event_parser: Callable[[str], tuple[str, dict[str, float | int | None]]] | None,
    name: str,
) -> AgentResult:
    try:
        stdout = completed.stdout.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
        raise AgentError(f"{name} CLI stdout was not valid UTF-8") from exc
    text, usage = (stdout.strip(), {}) if event_parser is None else event_parser(stdout)
    reported_model = provider_reported_model(stdout)
    return AgentResult(
        text=text,
        raw_stdout=stdout,
        raw_stderr="",
        exit_code=completed.returncode,
        provider=name,
        usage=usage,
        reported_model=reported_model,
    )


def _failed_stream(
    stream: NativeEventStream | None,
    stdout: bytes,
    parser: Callable[[str], tuple[str, dict[str, float | int | None]]] | None,
    name: str,
) -> None:
    if stream is None:
        _record_partial_usage(stdout, parser)
    else:
        _record_agent_usage(stream.partial_usage)
        _record_native_transport(stream, name, "failed")


def _record_native_transport(stream: NativeEventStream, name: str, status: str) -> None:
    diagnostics = {"provider": name, **stream.diagnostics()}
    activities = captured_agent_activities()
    if activities:
        for activity in activities:
            activity.record_event("native_transport", status, detail=json.dumps(diagnostics))
    trace_module.record_agent_model(diagnostics["reported_model"])
    ctx = trace_module.current()
    if ctx is not None:
        ctx.agent_transport.append({"status": status, **diagnostics})
        trace_module.checkpoint("agent-transport")


def _record_partial_usage(
    stdout: bytes,
    event_parser: Callable[[str], tuple[str, dict[str, float | int | None]]] | None,
) -> None:
    if not stdout or event_parser is None:
        return
    try:
        _, usage = event_parser(stdout.decode("utf-8"))
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, AgentError):
        return
    _record_agent_usage(usage)


def _report_agent_diagnostic(name: str, data: bytes) -> None:
    detail = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
    if detail:
        print(f"{name} CLI stderr: {detail}", file=sys.stderr)

            assert authority is not None

    """Answer successive structured attempts in order, recording each prompt."""

    def __init__(self, *answers: str) -> None:

        self.prompts.append(prompt)

def test_class_3_recipe_body_writes_compile_execute_and_record_nested_steps(tmp_path, asynchronous):

    source = f"""import asyncio

@step

    return value.upper()

@recipe(output_root="out")

    write_json("metadata.json", {{"result": result}})
    verify_artifact(path)
    return result

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(workflow.cli())
"""
    if not asynchronous:

    skill = tmp_path / "SKILL.md"

            "<workspace>/out/nested",

    assert json.loads((tmp_path / "out/metadata.json").read_bytes()) == {"result": "READY"}
    [body] = run.records
    assert body.name == "workflow" and body.output == "READY"
    assert body.inputs == {"value": "ready"}
    assert [child.name for child in body.children] == ["inspect"]
    assert body.children[0].output == "READY"

):

    if error is KeyboardInterrupt:
        trace = tmp_path / "trace.json"

    else:
        run = workflow.run()
        assert not run.ok and run.error_type == "ValueError"
        [body] = run.records
        assert body.error == "ValueError: fixture failure"
        assert body.side_effects[0].completed is True
        validate_trace(serialize_run(run))
    assert current() is None
    assert (tmp_path / "started.txt").read_bytes() == b"started"
